summary: Plan digital campaigns, map audiences and report channel results with practical exercises. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Digital marketing planning helps entry-level marketers and communications staff connect audience needs with campaign activity and measurement. The course covers writing SMART briefs, using STP to map audience journeys, and aligning content and calls to action across channels. You also practise planning search and paid media, tagging links with UTM parameters, and interpreting campaign indicators in an Excel scorecard.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who plan, publish, coordinate or report digital campaigns and need a structured way to connect audience needs with channel activity.
modules: Paid-Media Economics with CTR and CPA
prerequisites: Basic workplace computer use and familiarity with websites and email are expected. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel available for the scorecard exercises.
